body.cap: Group photo after the ceremony of the FIX Innovation Awards 2026 | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Daegu Metropolitan City held the official presentation ceremony for the FIX Innovation Awards at the EXCO East Wing Open Seminar Room on Thursday, October 22, recognizing 31 innovative enterprises for exceptional technological competitiveness and breakthrough commercial viability. Serving as a flagship program of the Future Innovation Tech Expo 2026 (FIX 2026), the awards spotlighted high-impact developments spanning future mobility, robotics, artificial intelligence, and information and communication technology (ICT).

The ceremony brought together approximately 100 distinguished guests, including Jung-ki Kim, Vice Mayor for Administrative Affairs of Daegu Metropolitan City, as well as domestic and international media delegations, evaluation panel members, and corporate leadership from the honored companies. Celebrating its third year, the FIX Innovation Awards drew intense competition, receiving submissions from 209 technology enterprises. Notably, over 70% of the applicant pool—147 companies—held verified award-winning track records at major global exhibitions, including CES, highlighting the high technical bar of this year’s competition.

body.cap: (From left) ONEPREDICT, SWM, and PERSEUS receiving the Best of FIX Innovation Award | Photo by AVING News

body.x: A total of nine enterprises received top honors, capturing the Best of FIX Innovation Award across three primary industry categories. In the future mobility vertical, awards were presented to ONEPREDICT for its AI-powered predictive management system for industrial manufacturing facilities and production workflows; SWM for its high-level urban autonomous driving robotaxi software; PERSEUS for its virtualization architecture enabling centralized software integration and management of in-vehicle electronic control units (ECUs); and HJWAVE for its specialized high-precision radar antenna technology engineered for spatial obstacle detection in autonomous vehicles.

body.cap: (From left) HJWAVE, CENS, and Tesollo receiving the Best of FIX Innovation Award | Photo by AVING News

body.x: In the robotics division, the Best of FIX Innovation Award recognized Tesollo for its multi-joint dexterous robotic hands capable of delicate, human-like grasping, and AeiROBOT for its bipedal humanoid robotics platform, Alice 5. In the ICT and enterprise software sector, top honors went to CENS for its automated dielectric coolant spray technology designed for AI server thermal management; POTATONET for its AI-driven cybersecurity platform detecting obfuscated malicious domains and cyber threats; and WACE for its autonomous smart factory operations solution where artificial intelligence independently optimizes manufacturing stages and regulates industrial equipment.

body.cap: (From left) AeiROBOT, POTATONET, and WACE receiving the Best of FIX Innovation Award | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Beyond formal industry recognition, the award winners receive structured follow-up support for acceleration and commercialization to drive international scale. Daegu Metropolitan City and partner organizations provide recipient enterprises with a 30% discount on booth participation fees for the subsequent edition of FIX, direct entry into the Korea Credit Guarantee Fund U-CONNECT Demo Day, and pitch allocations for the FIX 2026 Startup Arena investor relations (IR) sessions and global venture capital networking forums. Furthermore, awardees receive preferential consideration for glocal startup expansion programs partnered with Plug and Play (PNP), pre-matched buyer meetings, and coordinated coverage across domestic and international news networks.

body.cap: Jung-ki Kim, Vice Mayor for Administrative Affairs of Daegu Metropolitan City, giving congratulatory speech | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Jung-ki Kim, Vice Mayor for Administrative Affairs of Daegu Metropolitan City, stated that the strong participation of enterprises with prior global award credentials underscores the world-class technological excellence showcased at FIX 2026. He noted that the awards program is structured not merely to confer titles but to serve as a tangible springboard that translates technological ingenuity into direct investment, global market expansion, and sustainable, long-term enterprise growth.
